messages:
eli: Hey team — customer completed signup + Stripe 3DS in EU but never got the free trial credits. acct=acct_0G7x email=eli_customer@example.com user_id=usr_9d2 payment_intent=pi_35Zx
maria_support: Thanks. Can you paste the checkout/payment ids and region? I will pull webhooks and logs.
eli: payment_intent=pi_35Zx user_id=usr_9d2 region=EU
maria_support: Pulling webhooks. pinging payments-bot for timeline @payments-bot
payments-bot: webhook timeline for pi_35Zx received: 2026-02-24T14:07:19Z status=3ds_authenticated; provider=Stripe
payments-bot: async provider callback: domain_check(triggered)=started at 2026-02-24T14:07:19.700Z; domain_check=clear at 2026-02-24T14:07:22.100Z (Clearbit)
maria_support: hm, it shows the domain check cleared ~2.4s after 3DS. checking grant worker logs.
maria_support: grant worker ran at 2026-02-24T14:07:20Z and skipped due to gating flag. jordan, can payments confirm gating cause?
jordan: saw the same timeline. domain_check initially flagged the email domain as 'business' requiring manual vet; that flag was cleared after the async Clearbit lookup completed. Unfortunately the grant job processed between those events and skipped the auto-grant. Looks like an ordering/race issue.
eli: so the grant job doesn't re-evaluate gating state after provider callbacks complete? customer stuck without trial quota.
jordan: yes — current flow: on 3ds_auth event grant_worker reads gating_state and either grants or skips. we don't currently have a short retry window to re-evaluate when async checks come back.
samir_ops: I can apply credits manually now. running: `grant_credits --user usr_9d2 --amount 1000 --reason "manual post-auth domain-clear"`
payments-bot: manual grant executed by samir_ops at 2026-02-24T14:11:03Z -> grant_id=g_20260224_002 amount=1000
samir_ops: verified balance update and usage record. emailing user with apology and confirmation of credits + 24h elevated support.
eli: customer replied thanks, confirmed they can run test calls.
maria_support: filing bug INFR-3499: credits-award worker does not re-check gating state after 3ds/provider callbacks; race when Clearbit/domain checks are async. Assigning to eng-runtime.
jordan: proposed fixes: (1) make grant job idempotent and enqueue a short re-check (7s) if gating=true on EU signups where async domain checks are enabled; (2) instrument Clearbit lookup latency and create an alert when >1s for signup flow; (3) add a background reconciler that scans skipped grants in last 30s and retries once. I'll open a PR.
samir_ops: temporary mitigation: flip a config to enable a 7s backoff retry window for grants in EU. I'll open PR #1298 with the change and short TTL.
maria_support: ticket SUP-11789 created for support follow-up (manual grant applied; user notified). Marking support side resolved. Please link ENG bug INFR-3499 to the ticket. :white_check_mark:
eli: saved relevant grant_worker logs:
```
INFO 2026-02-24T14:07:19 grant_worker processing user=usr_9d2 event=3ds_auth ts=1708800439
WARN 2026-02-24T14:07:20 gating_status=required reason=domain_business_flag
INFO 2026-02-24T14:07:20 grant_worker skipped grant user=usr_9d2
INFO 2026-02-24T14:11:03 manual_grant executed grant_id=g_20260224_002 by=samir_ops
```
maria_support: logs saved to SUP-11789. closing thread on support side.
ops-bot: automated note: add postmortem if recurrence > 3 incidents in 30d.
